key_insight: A transfer-learned, uncertainty-aware transformer can accurately screen greener solvent substitutes for emerging materials even when target-property data are scarce.
engineering_relevance: The tool helps high-throughput labs and materials engineers rank candidate solvents for organic photovoltaics and related applications while reducing trial-and-error experimentation.
method: Pre-train on QM9 molecular targets, then transfer to solvent-property prediction with minimal new data.
Add uncertainty quantification so users can judge prediction confidence during screening.
Deploy a customizable ranking workflow for solvent substitution and green solvent discovery.
evidence_signal: The model performs well on established targets like Hansen solubility parameters and dielectric constant, and also on low-data targets such as Gutmann donor and acceptor numbers, enabling large-scale augmentation of solubility descriptors.
watch_item: Performance may depend on the chemical similarity of new candidates to the pretraining domain, so uncertain predictions should be treated cautiously when screening novel solvents.
paper_title: A green solvent screening tool for emerging materials via uncertainty aware, transformer enhanced transfer learning
